failures.observed: A TypeScript worker resolved tsx from the desktop root and could not load the runtime dependency.
failures.resolution: Resolve the runtime loader to an absolute URL before spawning source workers.

failures.observed: Directory hints generated during vault initialization repeatedly invalidated a pending source.
failures.resolution: Immediate hints only target owner page paths; complete startup/periodic reconciliation handles directories.

failures.observed: The joined FTS query used an ambiguous generation_id column.
failures.resolution: Qualify FTS output columns; initialization/query failures return unavailable.

failures.observed: Windows list path separators split the owner subject; the original source key also included locator.
failures.resolution: Portable owner subject paths and subject-stable keys; pin changes advance intent and retire the old generation.

failures.observed: The saved enable selection omitted physical sessionId.
failures.resolution: Propagate, require and compare physical generation; background owner reads reject changed generations.

failures.observed: Slow scans could queue behind the periodic timer and prevent the idle barrier.
failures.resolution: Coalesce equivalent in-flight scans; include pending debounce/scan stability in idle.

failures.observed: node:sqlite count rows have a null prototype, so a strict whole-object assertion failed after successful cleanup.
The first wrapper invocation timed out preparing plugin boundary root shims after 300000ms.
failures.resolution: Final-candidate runtime lint completed with exit 0; original timeout retained.

failures.observed: The FTS coverage query used a Kysely function builder before its alias was in scope.
failures.resolution: Build the aggregate from the query expression context; final full node/web/test typecheck passed.

failures.observed: The lifecycle probe imported readFile without using it.
failures.resolution: Removed two unused probe/test imports and reran all final-candidate gates.

failures.observed: A changed owner range with the same full-file version/digest retained the old intent, eligibility and active generation.
failures.resolution: The complete source identity including its raw locator now advances intent. A new pending job replaces the old eligible generation; the old lease cannot publish.
